resources.string: Pass a calendar image or text to an AI to\nregister events into your calendar in bulk.
1. Copy the prompt\n2. Pass it to an AI app along with the image\n3. Paste back the returned JSON
Select parsed results with checkboxes.\nOnly checked events are added.
Pass it to an AI app
With "Back up photos too" OFF, events are saved as JSON;\nON saves a ZIP with photos.\nThe ZIP is for Golendar mode only.

"Save" exports events,
"Append" adds them while keeping existing ones,
"Restore" overwrites existing ones.
"Restore" is unavailable in Google mode.
When using "Append" in Google mode,\nyou can pick one writable calendar\nas the destination.
Golendar is self-contained in the app with no external sync;\nGoogle syncs with Google Calendar.\nSwitch depending on your needs.

Use checkboxes to show or hide events,
and tap a color circle to change its display color.
After adding or removing calendars on the device,
tap "Reload calendar list".

Checkboxes show/hide events, color circles change colors,
and tapping a name renames the calendar.
My Calendar cannot be deleted,
but it can be hidden.

Events in that calendar no longer appear
in the calendar, widgets, or notifications.
Holidays are shown only for the countries
selected under "Holidays".

Turn on "Pin display time zone" under Settings → Time zone to show the calendar in the selected region\'s time regardless of where the device is. Event times stay correct while traveling or on business trips.
Turn on "Match notification time to local clock" to be notified when the displayed time zone\'s clock reaches the event time. You won\'t miss events while traveling.
Same time regardless of device location
Notify by the displayed time zone clock
Under Settings → Holidays, select one or more from the G7, original BRICS members, Korea, Taiwan, and Hong Kong. Holidays on the same day are combined into one row with flag badges.
In Google mode, holidays from the selected countries take priority, and Google holidays on the same day are not duplicated. If no country is selected, no holidays are shown.
Same-day holidays share one row with flags
Google holidays on the same day are hidden
Tap "Color" in the event edit screen to change the color of just that event. It takes priority over the calendar color.
Choosing "Default (purple)" restores the calendar color. Use colors to tell apart important or family events across calendars.
Choose a color for each event
The calendar permission has been permanently denied, so the system permission dialog cannot be shown.\n\nOpen "Settings" → "Apps" → "Golendar" → "Permissions" → "Calendar" and allow it.
Swipe up/down to move between periods
In month, week, or day view, quickly swipe twice in the same direction to move to the previous or next period.
Swipe left or right to switch between day, week, and month views.\nThe album is included too when the Album tab is on.
Try adding an event now.\nLong-press the home screen icon to use shortcuts, too.
Enter a place name or address in the search field\nat the top of the map and run the search.\nTap a suggestion to move the map there.
Choose a location with the pin
Move the map to place the center pin on the location,\nthen save it with "OK".
Each tap cycles the mode:\n"Follow → Compass follow → OFF".
Locations are saved as "POI name, address",\ninteroperable with Google Maps and other apps.
Use the icon at the left of the monthly header\nto turn the event list under the calendar on or off.\nTurning it OFF makes the month grid larger.
Tap a date for a popup
With the bottom list OFF,\ntapping a date shows that day\'s events\nin a popup.
Allow notifications to receive them\nat event start times or 10 minutes before.
The "Alarms & reminders" permission is needed\nto deliver notifications exactly on time.
Disabling battery optimization is recommended\nto prevent notification delays during sleep.
The notification permission has been permanently denied, so the system permission dialog cannot be shown.\n\nOpen "Settings" → "Apps" → "Golendar" → "Notifications" and enable them.
Two timing types, "On time" and "10 minutes before",\ncan be toggled individually.\nHolidays and cultural events are not notified.
The "Alarms & reminders" permission is recommended\nto deliver notifications exactly on time.
Disabling battery optimization is recommended\nto prevent notification delays during sleep.
From the "+" button on the event editor, you can attach\nup to 5 photos (downscaled to 1920px on the long side).\nGolendar mode only.
Tap a thumbnail in the details to view full screen.\n"Save" exports to Pictures/Golendar,\n"Share" sends to other apps.
Turn on the Album tab in Custom settings to add\nan Album tab next to Day, Week, and Month.\nTap a photo and use "Go to date" to jump to the month view.
Choose from Daily / Weekdays / Weekly / Monthly / Yearly.\n"Weekdays" repeats Monday through Friday only.
"End" is the duration of a single occurrence;\nthe "repeat end date" is the final day of the whole series.
Recurring events cannot be deleted for a single day only.\nTo change one occurrence, remove the recurrence\nand split it into individual events first.
Tap the "+ Add Event" button in the bottom right of the monthly view\nto add an event on the selected date.
In weekly view, use the "+ Add event" button\nunder each date to create that day\'s events.
Long-press the home screen icon\nto launch "Add Event" directly.
+ Add Event button in the bottom right
Tap an event card to open its details,\nthen use the "Edit" button to change it.
The "Delete" button in the editor\nremoves the event permanently.
For events spanning multiple days,\n"Delete only this day" keeps the other days.\n* The event is split into two.
From the search icon in the header,\nyou can search event titles.
The range is 2 years back to 2 years ahead.\nHolidays, cultural events, and birthdays are excluded.\nTap a result to jump to that date.
Holidays, cultural events, and birthdays are excluded
Day, week, and month widgets can be placed freely\non the home screen.\nThey follow the theme and background color.
Long-press the home screen icon\nto launch "Add Event", "Today", or "Search"\ndirectly.
